claims.claim: All six public memory capabilities execute through the bounded capability executor.
Trusted scope cannot be overridden through capability arguments.
Cross-user search, inspect, correction, and supersession are blocked by scope.
Correction preserves supersession lineage rather than silently replacing history.
Optional semantic ranking receives only already-scoped candidates.

non_claims: This repository does not reproduce Nexus Synapse.
This repository is not evidence of current production Nexus memory behavior.
This repository does not contain the private general-purpose runtime executor.
This repository does not contain production schemas or production query logic.
